name: Patta Chicken
instructions: 1. Grind coriander and chilies into a paste. 2. Marinate chicken and wrap in banana leaves. 3. Roast on charcoal until charred and tender.
description: Chicken marinated in a fragrant coriander-based masala, wrapped in banana leaves.
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
